messages:
maria (design): quick UX notes from today's research — need quick sync. compact preview in the rules editor has 3 observable issues: screen reader doesn't announce reorders during simulation, keyboard focus jumps when sim updates, and the validation pill overlaps the preview header on narrow widths. cc @kevin @ashley
kevin (pm): thanks — which sim state? can you share repro steps?
maria (design): repro steps: open policy > Rules tab > enable 'Preview simulation' > reorder rules by drag > run sim. VoiceOver only says "list, 4 items" when I move something, not "Rule X moved to position 2". also when sim runs the top preview blinks and focus jumps out of the list.
ashley (frontend): can repro in Chrome + NVDA. looks like we re-render the whole list on reorder so SR only sees new list count. aria-live=polite exists but it's on the container and gets re-mounted. we should preserve DOM nodes or emit a dedicated sr-only live message.
sam (eng): agree. preserving DOM nodes is ideal but emitting a short live text is faster. something like: `Moved rule "Block external" to position 2` inserted into an offscreen `div[aria-live="assertive"]`.
maria (design): also accessibility for validation states: we show a red dot badge on the rule card but no accessible label. suggest adding inline text `Priority conflict — rule unreachable` and exposing it via aria-describedby on the card.
kevin (pm): copy suggestion: shorter: `Priority conflict — unreachable`. clearer for reading/announcements?
oliver (prodops): :thumbsup: shorter reads better in SRs. also propose we add a summary announcement after a sim finishes: `Simulation complete — 12 routed to model-a, 3 to fallback`. helpful for low-vision users.
ashley (frontend): for narrow screens the error pill overlap is CSS — I'll reduce badge min-width and allow wrap. keyboard order: drag handle currently gets tabbed after title which is awkward; need to ensure handle is first in tab order and has `aria-label="Drag to reorder"`.
a11y-bot: axe scan results: 3 violations in the current build: 1) color-contrast: .rule-badge on purple bg fails 3:1, 2) aria-live semantics missing for reordering actions, 3) interactive drag handle missing aria-label. recommended fixes: bump contrast, add assertive sr-only announcements for moves, add aria-label to handle.
sam (eng): I'll take the aria-live impl and the sr-only announce component. ashley — can you own the CSS/contrast changes? kevin — want to decide the final copy strings?
kevin (pm): i'll create tickets: INF-3421 aria-live reorder announcements, INF-3422 validation copy + accessible labels, INF-3423 compact-preview CSS & contrast. target PRs by EOW next week.
maria (design): nice. last UX ask — can we add a small "how this reads" toggle in the simulation panel so writers can preview what the screen reader announcement will be? would help iterate copy quickly.
kevin (pm): good idea, adding to INF-3422. thanks everyone — will assign.
